tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across API modules, endpoints (name, path, description) and the integration guides (Shop Micro Frontend, Guidelines, Webhooks). Returns ranked hits with ids usable in get_endpoint / get_guide.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: All top-level ADITUS API modules with direction (inbound = your systems call ADITUS, outbound = ADITUS data into your systems), endpoint counts and documentation URLs. Also lists the integration guides.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: Every endpoint of one module (id, method, path, sub-group, one-line summary). Use the module id from list_modules.

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Full contract of one endpoint: method, URL, auth, query and header parameters, request body example, example responses (large bodies truncated, full text on the docs page). Accepts the endpoint id from search/list, or 'METHOD /path'.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Markdown of an integration guide. 'micro-frontend' is the Shop Micro Frontend contract (mounting, sessions, styling, Web Component, lifecycle, security); module guides such as 'guidelines' or 'webhooks' come from the API reference. Pass a section heading to fetch only that section.
